How cool!|audio = FrostWave36-2.ogg|'''Professor V''' on Wave 36 of [[Frost Mode]]}} }} ==Description== '''Professor V''' is a scientist for the [[T.D.S. Organization]]. She is the narrator for the [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]] map from the [[Operation I.C.E Event]], and briefly featured in the [[Ducky Revenge Event]] cutscenes where she recruited [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] for future work. She also appeared in [[Outpost 16]] during the [[Null & Void Event]], [[Casual Mode|Casual]], [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]], [[Molten Mode|Molten]], [[Frost Mode|Frost]], [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]], [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] and [[Story Mode|Story]] modes. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Regular |'''Professor V''' has tan skin and a dark purple hair. She wears blue pants with a black belt, white lab coat with a wrench and screws in its pockets, metal armbands with neon blue lights, grey knee-pads and a grey chestplate. She can hold either a gun or a clipboard in her animations. |Hardcore |'''Professor V''' has tan skin and a dark purple hair with certain parts being colored violet. She wears a black turtleneck, blue pants with a black belt, white lab coat with a wrench and screws in its pockets, metal armbands with neon blue lights, grey knee-pads and a grey chestplate.
